verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never names a design-tool integration (such as Figma or Adobe) or any way to update monday status from inside a design app. The only related material is generic: '850+ integrations', '2-way sync with any platform', and APIs/SDKs to build custom integrations. Those are broad marketing claims and developer building blocks, not a documented designer workflow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps
